# surflist

> surflist is a directory for surf trips: surf schools, independent surf shops, places to stay (camps, hostels, eco-pods, campervans) and surf services like board repair. Browse by country and region. Verified listings have their own profile page with location and pricing.

## Sections

- [Surf schools](https://surflist.co/surf-schools/): Learn to surf or level up with schools and coaches near the break.
- [Surf shops](https://surflist.co/surf-shops/): Independent surf shops for boards, wetsuits, rentals and repairs.
- [Places to stay](https://surflist.co/surf-stays/): Surf camps, hostels, eco-pods and campervans close to the waves.
- [Surf services](https://surflist.co/surf-services/): Board repair, ding fixes and other surf services.

## Verified surf schools

- [Newquay Surf School](https://surflist.co/surf-schools/newquay-surf-school/): surf school in Newquay, Cornwall, United Kingdom — Fistral Beach lessons in the UK's surf capital.

## Verified surf shops

- [Gulf Stream Surf Shop](https://surflist.co/surf-shops/gulf-stream-surf-shop/): surf shop in Newquay, Cornwall, United Kingdom — Independent shop and rental just back from Fistral.

## Verified places to stay

- [Fistral Surf Camp](https://surflist.co/surf-stays/fistral-surf-camp/): place to stay in Newquay, Cornwall, United Kingdom — Week-long surf-and-stay packages by the beach.

## Verified surf services

- [Ding Doctor Cornwall](https://surflist.co/surf-services/ding-doctor-cornwall/): surf service in Newquay, Cornwall, United Kingdom — Fast ding and fin-box repairs, collection available.

## About

Basic listings are free and link out to each business; verified listings get a dedicated page with address, coordinates and pricing. To get listed, email hello@surflist.co.
